name: camayoc_dora_open_changes
description: Work in progress (aegis-rb3): changes of one repository opened before the instant and neither merged nor abandoned at it, with their opening time; age is the instant minus opened. From aegis:ChangeEvent. Graph scope: camayoc window graphs, plus the one staged backfill graph named by {staging}; no other named graph is read.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(?openedAt) AS ?opened) WHERE { GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?go), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?go = <{staging}>) && STR(?openedAt) < "{end}") FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH ?gc { ?x a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction ?closing ; aegis:occurredAt ?closedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gc), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gc = <{staging}>) && ?closing IN ("merged", "abandoned") && STR(?closedAt) < "{end}") } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?opened

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu

params.name: staging
params.description: exact IRI of the one reviewed staged-backfill graph read alongside the window graphs (aegis-rb3 B2); pass an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none, when there is none
